description.value: Best Western Inn at Penticton is a full-service hotel on Skaha Lake Road, positioned between Skaha Lake and downtown Penticton in the heart of Okanagan cycling country. The property features an indoor pool and hot tub, complimentary breakfast, and rooms with kitchenette options. It sits near the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and the Penticton waterfront, making it a practical base for multi-day touring cyclists.
